source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of genetic engineering in agriculture (PDF 240-241).

blocks.text: Zaraat mein genetic engineering kisi jandaar ke DNA ko khaas genes daal kar, nikal kar ya badal kar tabdeel karna hai. Is se matloob khoobiyon wali genetically modified (GM) fasalein banayi jati hain.

items: Pehchan: scientists matloob khoobi wala mufeed gene pehchante hain, maslan bacterium se keeron ke khilaf mazahmat ya khushk-sali bardasht karna.
Alehdgi: khoobi ka zimmedar gene jandaar se alag kiya jata hai.
Dakhla: alag kiya gene gene gun ya carrier bacterium ke zariye hadaf paude ke genome mein dala jata hai, jo gene ko paude ke DNA tak pohanchata hai.
Izhar: paude ke cells naye gene ka izhar karte hain, yun tabdeel shuda paude woh protein banata hai jo pehle nahi bana sakta tha aur nai khoobi hasil karta hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar qadam baen se daen teeron se jure: 1. Identification, DNA double helix par magnifier, tag Identify; 2. Isolation, qainchi DNA ka tukra kaat'ti hai, label Vector, tag Snip; 3. Insertion, gene aur syringe use cell mein daalti hai, tag Move; 4. Expression, patton aur surkh phalon wala paudha, tag Grow.

blocks.text: GM fasalon mein keeron aur bimariyon ke khilaf behtar mazahmat, herbicides bardasht karne ki salahiyat aur behtar ghizaiyat ho sakti hai. Is se paidawar barh sakti aur kuch pesticides ki zarurat kam ho sakti hai. Maslan Bt cotton apna pesticide khud banati hai, jis se kimiyai spray kam hote hain, aur Golden Rice ko taraqqi-pazeer mulkon mein andhapan rokne ke liye beta-carotene ke saath banaya gaya hai. Khadshat mein GM genes ka jangli paudon tak phailna (outcrossing); 'superweeds', jab herbicide-mazahmati genes cross-pollination se GM fasalon se jangli jari-bootiyon mein chale jayein aur unhein maarna bohat mushkil bana dein; mazahmati keere; aur insani sehat aur hayatiyati tanawwu par taveel asraat shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Fungicides ke istemal ke do bare zarai faide batayein.
blocks.explanation: Yeh fasalon ko phaphoondi bimariyon se bacha kar paude sehatmand rakhte, aur yun paidawar barhate aur khurak ka zayaa kam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Tezabi barish ke sulphuric acid ko neutralise karne ke liye pisa chuna-pathar (CaCO3) dalne par hone wale reaction ki balanced equation likhein.
Do khoobiyan batayein jo scientists nai fasalon mein mausami tabdeeli ke muqable ke liye paida karna chahte hain.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: khushk-sali bardasht, garmi bardasht, selab (pani mein doobna) bardasht, namak bardasht.

items: Genetic engineering: pehchan, alehdgi, dakhla (gene gun ya bacterium), izhar.
GM faide: keeron se mazahmat, herbicide bardasht, ghizaiyat (Bt cotton, Golden Rice).
Khadshat: outcrossing, superweeds, mazahmati keere, taveel asraat.
